$comment: The routes of the advanced stage. Each names its route policy, its placement profiles and the provider (the model) it targets. Compare routes independently: different profiles produce different requests from the same tools and guard.

incident-agent.title: Route 1: incident-agent
incident-agent.summary: Instructions in the system channel once; state before evidence and observations; observations kept for an hour with no cap. The model reached through the OpenAI-style endpoint.

incident-agent-reinforced.title: Route 2: incident-agent-reinforced
incident-agent-reinforced.summary: The same tools and guard, a different route for a model reached through the Anthropic-style endpoint: instructions restated just before the query, evidence and observations ahead of state, the output contract next to the query, and a tighter input budget under which the evidence chunks take their supplied summaries while every observation stays.
differences: governance.instructions is placed twice: in the system channel and again as <instructions> right before the query; the trace counts both occurrences
evidence and observations come before the user profile and the task state, and the output contract sits next to the query
budget.input is 620 instead of 1400: as observations accumulate, the route's fitting order compresses the evidence chunks to their summaries (compressed rows), and nothing protected moves
the provider is the Anthropic-style endpoint, so the outbound request is a Messages API request: system blocks and one user message
